info.name: JobMate
info.description:
Gateway API. Payloads include every DTO field.

1. baseUrl: http://localhost:5007 (IntelliJ) or http://localhost:5050 (Compose).
2. Run Auth signups then logins — Tests store JWTs.
3. adminToken only works for an existing ROLE_ADMIN; signup cannot create admins.
4. Do not send X-User-Id; the gateway sets identity from the JWT.
5. After create company/job/resume, copy ids into collection variables (or edit the Tests tab).

request.description: SignupRequest: fullName, email, password (min 8), phone, role
LoginRequest: email, password. Tests save seekerToken.
Use an existing ROLE_ADMIN. Signup cannot create admins.
